items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: And Donald won in the seminary. He didn't care for it at all.

ctx.x: Yeah, and she was on the stage. She went to many benefits at the Jerusalem temple. She didn't perform for money, just at benefits. She'd go. And I'd have to... She'd wear tights and nice costumes. But she was a great dancer. She loved to dance. And then she got married so young. Then she just settled down. No more dancing. But I bet you she can still dance. You can see her dancing around there with a grandchild. I don't think Roland danced as much as his mother. And Donald won in the seminary. He didn't care for…
Well, he didn't get much of a chance at dancing in the seminary.
